question: What capacity retention did the uncoated and the Al2O3 (2%)-coated Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2 cathodes show?
expect: 92.43% before (251→232) and 94.83% after coating (271→257), 0.05C, 30 cycles (p13.T4 r5)
rendered: According to Table 4, the uncoated Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2 cathode showed a capacity retention of 92.43% after 30 cycles at 0.05C, and the Al2O3 (2%)-coated Li1.2Mn0.54Ni0.13Co0.13O2 cathode showed a capacity retention of 94.83% after 30 cycles at 0.05C.
